verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents an extensibility layer: Functions as modular Python plugins, SKILL.md-based skills, external tool servers and MCP tool connections. Nothing in the pack shows a browsable registry or marketplace, or a one-command or one-click install flow. Missing for 10: evidence of a real browsable skills/plugins registry, one-click/one-command install, discovery/versioning of community plugins, and independent hands-on corroboration.
